# Bible Adventure Requirements Skill

## Purpose

This skill defines the requirements-first development process for:

Bible Adventure: Journey to Understanding Who GOD Is.

The goal of the game is to encourage children and other players
to genuinely read the Bible with the intention of seeking GOD.

The game is not a replacement for Scripture.

> The game is not the destination. The Bible is the destination.

---

## Core Rule

Do not begin significant implementation until the requirement
being implemented is sufficiently defined.

Every implementation must be traceable to a requirement.

Requirement
    ↓
Task
    ↓
Implementation
    ↓
Test
    ↓
Acceptance Criteria
